transkript.t: These six free GitHub repos get 10 times more out of your Claude.
And the last one figures out how almost any app is built.
With it, Claude turns a web page into a real video, right in your branding.
The second one is Matt Pocock's Skills.
With Grilmi, Claude asks you 20 questions first instead of just guessing.
The third one is a tiny text AI that sorts your emails and comments locally for $0.
The fourth one is 200 moving shader backgrounds that make any website look expensive instantly.
The fifth one turns a single sentence into a clean diagram, from flowchart to timeline.
And the last one is REA.
You show Claude an app and it rebuilds how it works.
On its own, Claude is an assistant.
With these six, it becomes your whole studio.
Comment repos and I'll send you all six links.
